heroDesc: SehatSetu brings doctors, patients, health records, intelligent assistance, and essential healthcare services together in one accessible digital platform.
heroDescSecondary: Built to make quality healthcare easier to reach across both rural and urban India.
storyP1: This didn't start in a classroom. It started on a trip to rural India — sitting in villages where the nearest doctor was hours away, where a fever that would mean a same-day appointment in a city meant days of waiting, traveling, and hoping it wasn't serious.
storyP2: That gap stayed with us. Healthcare access is India's most urgent public health challenge, and it isn't abstract — it's a mother who can't get to a checkup in time, a family that delays care because the nearest clinic is a bus ride and a day's wages away.
storyP3: One thing became clear early on: some patients can't afford to wait. Pregnant women and young children are among the most medically vulnerable, and the most time-sensitive — a warning sign missed by a few days can be the difference between a manageable risk and an emergency. So alongside the platform's core care, we built dedicated maternal and child health tracking — monitoring the vitals that matter most, flagging risk early, and making sure the most fragile patients are never the ones falling through the cracks.
storyP4: We didn't build SehatSetu to be another app. We built it because the people most affected by healthcare gaps are usually the ones with the least power to close them themselves — and that felt like something worth building for.
missionText: Make trusted healthcare services easier to access, understand, and manage through technology.
missionHeadline: To put a trusted doctor within reach of every Indian — not eventually, but now.
missionP1: We're building a platform where secure video consultations replace long journeys, where AI turns a doctor's spoken words into accurate records instead of hours of paperwork, and where every patient's history travels with them — safe, private, and always available when it matters most.
missionP2: Our mission isn't just to digitize healthcare. It's to make sure geography, income, and infrastructure never stand between a person and the care they deserve — through technology that serves patients first, and doctors second to none.
visionText: Build a connected healthcare experience where distance, language, and digital complexity do not prevent people from receiving timely care.
visionHeadline: A future where your zip code doesn't decide your health outcomes.
visionP1: Where a farmer in a village and a professional in a metro city have the same door to walk through — trusted doctors, real care, no distance in the way.
visionP2: SehatSetu exists to make that future arrive sooner: healthcare that's secure, accessible, affordable, and built for every Indian — not despite where they live, but regardless of it.

aiHeadline: AI That Assists — Doctors Still Decide
aiDesc: SehatSetu uses artificial intelligence to make healthcare workflows more efficient, such as organizing information, assisting with healthcare navigation, and supporting structured medical documentation.
aiDesc2: AI-generated information is designed to support—not replace—qualified healthcare professionals. Diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions, and critical medical decisions remain under human medical supervision.
aiPoint1: Human-in-the-loop — AI supports structured workflows reviewed by qualified professionals.
aiPoint2: Safety-first emergency handling — high-risk situations always direct to urgent in-person care.
aiPoint3: Structured and reviewable AI output — responses are organized, traceable, and human-reviewable.
accessibilityDesc: SehatSetu is designed with both rural and urban healthcare access in mind. Digital consultations, nearby hospital discovery, lightweight healthcare workflows, and multilingual support can help reduce barriers caused by distance and digital complexity.
privacyDesc: Protecting your health information is fundamental to everything we do. SehatSetu applies secure authentication, controlled access to medical records, privacy-conscious AI integration, and secure handling of documents and communications.
privacyPoint2: Protected health information with controlled access
